div.div: فَحْلٌ هَضَّاضٌ A stallion that breaks, or crushes, the necks of the [other] stallions; (S, A, K;) as also ↓ هَضْهَاضٌ : (JK, K:) or a stallion that throws down a man, and a camel, then leans, bears, or presses, upon him with his breast. (IDrd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
